item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:15 HKT 28/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. A cold front is expected to move across Guangdong between tomorrow night and Sunday morning, the weather will be cold over the region early next week. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon and its replenishment, it will be cloudy, rainy and windy with weather remaining rather cool over the coast of southern China in the Lunar New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 28/01 (Friday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Misty at first. Sunny intervals during the day. A few rain patches at night.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 29/01 (Saturday)

Weather: Main cloudy with a few rain patches. Temperatures falling appreciably at night.
